title: Ribbon runs: Proof strip
summary: String runs. Return the whole result list in the order you built it.
descriptionMd:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
line is text. A character is one letter, digit, space, or punctuation mark. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", the result list is [2, 1, 2].

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete ribbonRunsProofStrip(line, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
unitIntro: A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", the result list is [2, 1, 2]. Each card first builds this result list, then asks for a different answer. Start with the first card. The last card also uses position numbers that start at 1.
constraints: k is a whole number from 1 to 8. Answers fit in a signed 32-bit integer: -2,147,483,648 through 2,147,483,647.
The text uses ASCII characters (a basic character set). Only an ordinary space separates words.
Efficiency goal: time O(n); extra memory, including the result list, O(n). n is the input length. These labels describe how work and memory grow with the input.
hints: Try a small example by hand. Follow Step 1 and write down its result list.

referenceSolutions.python:
def ribbonRunsProofStrip(line, k):
    a=line
    out=[]
    i=0
    while i<len(a):
        j=i+1
        while j<len(a) and a[j]==a[i]: j+=1
        out.append(j-i)
        i=j
    return out
